author: adversarial
text: Decisive closure of the pass-3 threshold computation, extended by exact computation to n=65536. The threshold weight w*(n) = min{w : exact-mean of nu2/n over weight-w strings >= 0.40} is w*(n) = n^0.555 * P(log2 n) with P a CONFIRMED bounded period-1-in-log2 correction (amplitude ~0.07). NOT c*sqrt(n): phase-1.0 OLS E=0.55499+-0.00202, 27 sigma from 0.5, and w^2/n rises 0.77->1.74 (not flat). NOT c*n^{log2(3)-1}: at 0.58496 the residual monotone-drifts 0.624->0.531, spread 0.093, while at 0.5568 it is bounded periodic spread 0.024. Log-periodicity verified by sampling non-power-of-two phases (n=768,1536,3072,5120,6144,10240,12288,20480,24576,40960,49152): w/n^0.555 flat at each fixed in-cell phase across many doublings (phase1.0: 0.730-0.750 over 9 doublings n=256..65536; phase1.25 ~0.807; phase1.5 0.779-0.800), phase means differing by amplitude ~0.069 — the textbook A006046 Pascal-mod-2 fluctuation form. Independent check: linear scan (mean is NON-MONOTONE in w by parity, so must scan not binary search) reproduces all 16 known w* exactly. Sublinear threshold => linear supply exact-mean-typical at ~n^0.555 switches, strictly weaker than positive mod-4 fraction. MEASURED-NOT-PROVED; per-n exact, exponent+periodic factor fitted over n<=65536. See code/out/threshold_weight_logperiodic_extended.txt
